description: SalesBreaker GTM lets ChatGPT operate the user's SalesBreaker workspace for internal CRM updates, collection management, task creation, template drafts, LP/proposal drafts, CSV staging, and sales preparation. It cannot send outreach, submit forms, execute campaigns or workflows, publish pages, export databases, change billing/authentication, operate infrastructure, or delete records.
